software.description: Open-source Android password manager for local KeePass database files.
software.downloadSize: Approximately 15 MiB APK (F-Droid 4.5.3; not installed size)

evidence.claim: KeePassDX documents local KeePass database support and multiple distribution channels.
F-Droid lists KeePassDX 4.5.3 (45300) as requiring Android 4.4+ and supporting arm64-v8a, armeabi-v7a, x86 and x86_64.

software.internetRequirement: Not required for local database use; external sync/storage can require network access
limitations: Users must design and secure their own synchronization and backups
software.name: KeePassDX
software.networkActivity: KeePassDX manages local KeePass databases; network behavior depends on external storage/synchronization choices

privacyDetails.collected: KeePassDX is designed around local KeePass database files and does not require a hosted KeePassDX account.
privacyDetails.controls: Users control database location, backup, synchronization method and encryption credentials.
privacyDetails.deletion: Deleting the app does not necessarily delete database copies stored elsewhere; users must manage database/backups separately.
privacyDetails.encryption: KeePassDX works with encrypted KeePass/KDBX databases; database security depends on configuration and credentials.
privacyDetails.practicalImplications: A local KDBX workflow can minimize service exposure, but privacy and availability depend heavily on how the database is backed up and synchronized.
privacyDetails.purpose: Open, edit and use encrypted KeePass database files on Android.
privacyDetails.recipients: No remote recipient is inherent to local-only use; a user-selected sync or storage provider may receive the database file.
privacyDetails.sharing: Sharing/synchronization depends on user-selected file workflows or external storage providers.

software.privacySummary: KeePassDX works with local encrypted databases; any cross-device sync depends on the storage provider the user chooses.
software.requirementEvidence: F-Droid 4.5.3 metadata and project documentation, checked 2026-09-22
